title: Career Roadmap: Data Curator
summary: Career Domain: Agriculture, Food & Life Sciences · Qualification Pathway: B.Sc – Bioinformatics · Target Career: Data Curator

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Data Curator in bioinformatics collects, checks and organises biological data (genes, proteins, variants, experiments) so scientists can trust and reuse it. It suits careful, detail-minded students who like both biology and data.

items.text: Extract data from papers and experiments into structured databases
Check records for errors and apply standard vocabularies (ontologies)
Write metadata so others can find and reuse datasets
Work with scientists and developers to improve databases
Biological data centres (e.g. Indian Biological Data Centre)
Learn molecular biology, genetics and biochemistry
Explore NCBI, UniProt and Ensembl databases
Learn SQL and data cleaning in Python/R
Study ontologies (Gene Ontology) and metadata standards
Curate a small dataset from published papers
Project with a lab or data centre curating a real dataset
Learn FAIR data principles and version control (Git)
Build a portfolio of curated datasets and scripts
Indian Biological Data Centre or bioinformatics institutes
